jsesh.mdcDisplayer.layout
Class SimpleViewBuilder

java.lang.Object
  jsesh.mdcDisplayer.layout.SimpleViewBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
ViewBuilder
public class SimpleViewBuilder
extends java.lang.Object
implements ViewBuilder

The purpose of this class is to build a view for a ModelElement hierarchy. After visiting a ModelElement, the currentView will be a correct view for the said element.

Concerning various text orientations : views are geometrically-oriented. They currently know nothing about text orientation. This means that for a right-to-left text, for instance, the subviews should be correctly placed by this builder.
